Check for new versions in the background. When off, you can still check manually at any time.
在后台检查新版本。关闭后，你仍可随时手动检查。
自定义应用的颜色主题
Automatically launch GitHub Copilot when you log in to your computer.
在你登录电脑时自动启动 GitHub Copilot。
Keep running when window is closed
When you close the window, keep GitHub Copilot running in the system tray instead of quitting.
关闭窗口时，让 GitHub Copilot 在系统托盘中继续运行，而不是退出。
Skip the confirmation dialog when deleting chats.
删除对话时跳过确认对话框。
Position of the find-in-workspace dialog when active.
在工作区查找对话框的显示位置。
Projects use the default account unless changed in project settings.
项目默认使用默认账号，除非在项目设置中更改。
Upgrade your Copilot plan for higher usage limits, premium models, AI reviews and more.
升级你的 Copilot 套餐以获得更高的用量限制、付费模型、AI 评审等。
AI credits are consumed based on model and token usage.
AI credits 消耗量取决于模型与 token 使用情况。
to continue after plan credits run out.
以在套餐 credits 用尽后继续使用。
Open the full sessions table to browse, rename, archive, or delete sessions and free up disk space.
打开完整的会话列表，浏览、重命名、归档或删除会话以释放磁盘空间。
Choose how much detail sessions show in the conversation view.
选择在会话视图中显示多少细节。
Collapse completed turn details behind a summary panel
在摘要面板后折叠已完成的对话回合细节
Group consecutive tool calls into a single panel
将连续的工具调用合并到一个面板中
Show every tool call and intermediate message
显示每一次工具调用和中间消息
Preferences that apply to every session across all projects. Copilot may also load instructions from files on this machine.
应用于所有项目所有会话的偏好设置。Copilot 还可能从本机文件加载指令。
Editable instructions stored by this app and added to new sessions.
由本应用存储的可编辑指令，会自动添加到新会话。
e.g., Prefer functional patterns. Write concise commit messages. Always add tests for new code.
例如：优先使用函数式风格。撰写简洁的提交信息。为新代码添加测试。
These files are discovered by the Copilot runtime and applied when enabled. Edit the source file to change them.
这些文件由 Copilot 运行时自动发现，启用后生效。请修改源文件以变更它们。
未找到基于文件的指令。
无需询问即可运行工具。
Append a short attribution line to the replies agent merge posts when it resolves review comments, noting they were made automatically by the GitHub Copilot app.
在智能体合并发布的内容中追加一行简短归属说明，表明这是由 GitHub Copilot 应用自动生成的。
Choose when new local sessions ask before running tools.
选择新的本地会话何时在运行工具前询问。
Choose a light or dark appearance and a color variant.
选择浅色或深色外观以及配色变体。
Customize the terminal's appearance independently from the app.
独立于应用外观自定义终端的外观。
Set the font used for embedded terminals.
设置嵌入式终端使用的字体。
Pick a color palette for the app.
为应用选择一套配色方案。
